senderOnboarding.title: Sender onboarding
senderOnboarding.subtitle: Save drafts anytime. Publish live jobs after CLOX verifies your account.
senderOnboarding.waitingOpsBody: CLOX is reviewing your account ({{status}}). You can still save drafts — they stay private until you publish after approval.
senderOnboarding.waitingOpsDraftNote: Any draft jobs stay hidden from carriers until you are verified and publish.
senderOnboarding.opsRequestedInfo: CLOX asked for more info{{note}}. Update your profile or documents, then resubmit.
senderOnboarding.activeTitle: You're verified — publish jobs to carriers
senderOnboarding.activeBody: Drafts stay private until you publish. Carriers bid, you accept & pay, then track delivery.
senderOnboarding.activeBodyPublish: You're verified. Publish draft jobs so carriers can bid. Add a payment card under Account before accepting a bid.
senderOnboarding.storyDraftVsLive: Drafts are private. Live jobs appear on the carrier board after you publish.
senderOnboarding.resumeJobHint: Finish verification so CLOX can review you. Your draft job stays private until you publish after approval.
senderOnboarding.accountBusinessHint: Book on behalf of a company — ABN verification.
senderOnboarding.submitSuccess: Submitted to Ops for review. We’ll update you when there’s a decision.
senderOnboarding.paymentRepairNotice: Booking is paused until a live payment method is on file. Practice/mock cards from earlier testing no longer work — add a real card below (test card 4242… is fine in Stripe test mode).
senderOnboarding.paymentMockHint: Practice mode — no real card or charges. Click Set up, then Confirm.
senderOnboarding.paymentLiveHint: Add a company card so Clox can charge the fare when you accept a bid. Card details are entered on Stripe’s secure form (not stored on Clox).
senderOnboarding.paymentStep1: Click “Add card securely” to open Stripe’s card form.
senderOnboarding.paymentStep2: Enter a card (test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry, any CVC, any postcode).
senderOnboarding.paymentStep3: Click “Save card & continue” — Clox only stores a Stripe payment-method id.
senderOnboarding.setupIntentMock: Practice setup {{id}} — click Confirm to activate
senderOnboarding.setupIntentReady: Enter your card below, then save.
senderOnboarding.paymentStripeError: Could not save the card. Check the details and try again.
senderOnboarding.paymentMissingPm: Stripe did not return a payment method. Try again.
senderOnboarding.paymentMissingPublishable: Stripe publishable key is missing on the server. Ask ops to set STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

senderRegister.title: Sender registration
senderRegister.subtitle: Create a sender account to book loads.
